title: Concept: EJS template error returned to a client
description: A EJS template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The snippet shows the view source and the variable names the server binds, which is a map of the rendering context.
applicability: Deployments that render a EJS template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The snippet shows the view source and the variable names the server binds, which is a map of the rendering context.
